narrative: Coopercabruca made five contributions to Agroverse and TrueSight DAO from June 2023 to February 2025. These spanned Bring Liquidity by paying DAO expenses in USD, Commerce by sourcing for vendors, offline Commerce tasks requiring 30 minutes, earning 100 TDG for one hour of human effort, and injecting liquidity at 1 TDG per USD. A notable accomplishment was covering expenses in USD on behalf of the DAO.
